title: Events toggle shows and hides event blocks on the grid
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. At least one event and one shift exist on the visible range.
3. You are on the Schedule page with Events ON (default).
custom_steps:
1. Turn OFF Events in 'View Options'.
2. Look at the grid.
3. Turn it back ON.
custom_expected:
1. Off: event blocks disappear from the grid; shifts remain.
2. On: the events reappear unchanged.
